model: INMBSLGE001R000 LG AC to Modbus RTU gateway
applies_to: One LG indoor unit on the BYR (wired remote) bus via INMBSLGE001R000 (legacy code LG-RC-MBS-1), user manual v1.9 (01/2024).
summary: Modbus RTU server that sits on the 3-wire remote-controller bus of an LG indoor unit, alongside or instead of the LG wired remote. Holding registers cover on/off, mode, fan, vanes, setpoint, room temperature, compressor status and run hours, alarm and error code, and window-contact / virtual-temperature features.

addressing.note: Tables give a 'protocol address' (base 0) and a 'PLC address' (base 1); the protocol address is the wire address and is used for 'documented'.

source.title: Intesis INMBSLGE001R000 Modbus RTU (EIA-485) Interface for LG air conditioners - User's Manual

notes: Every register is documented as a 16-bit unsigned holding register and no temperature range in the manual goes below zero, so temperatures are UINT16. The 'no value' marker the manual writes as -32768 is raw 0x8000 (32768) and is listed as an enum entry.

Temperature registers depend on DIP SW4: x1 °C, x10 °C (decidegrees) or °F (no °F x10). The register-table footnote calls x10 the default, but the SW4 table and the quick-start page (all other switches off) give x1 °C as the factory setting, so scale 1 / °C is used. Read SW4 position 1-2 on site: if x10 is set use scale 0.1; if °F is set the values are whole °F.
Error code enum (LG codes) not reproduced; see manual section 7.

integration.summary: Decide the BYR-bus role first (SW1: slave next to an LG wired remote, master if there is none), set address and baud on SW3/SW4, power-cycle, then poll holding registers 0-11 with function 03 and write with 06.
integration.enable: No enable step; register 7 (gateway disablement) must be 0 for commands to reach the unit.
quirks: Temperature scale depends on DIP SW4 and the manual is inconsistent about the factory default.
setup: SW1: BYR-bus role (slave by default, needs an LG wired remote as master) and LG error type.
SW3: slave address; SW3/SW4: baud (9600 default).
DIP changes need a power cycle; the gateway only talks once the AC unit is powered.
gotchas: With the factory slave setting and no LG wired remote on the bus, the gateway will not communicate with the unit.
Writing register 22 starts virtual temperature: the gateway offsets the unit setpoint, so the LG remote may show a different setpoint than register 4.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
